4w.unchanged_vs_release_1_5: git diff 985c1ceccc on this file and its yaml is empty
4w.inner_loop: per thread TILE_M=8 x TILE_N=4 (yaml:12-13). Per K step of 4: one ivec4 weight load (uses half, lines 218-243), one f16vec4 scale load (254); per k_inner: 2 f16vec4 activation loads (259-263), 4 nibble extracts + int16->fp16 convert + multiply by scale (277-283), then 8 f16vec4 FMAs acc_T[m] += B[m] * dw_vec (288-292). DTYPE half -> ACC_VEC4_T f16vec4 (85-91): scalar/vector fp16 FMA, fp16 accumulate, no cooperative matrix, no integer dot.
4w.compute_mix_per_k_inner_per_thread: 32 fp16 FMAs (8 vec4) vs 4 dequant chains (shift, mask, sub, cvt, mul)

8da4w.unchanged_vs_release_1_5: git diff empty for the .glsl, .yaml and the compute .glslh; the only SARC change among linear_*.glslh is an #ifndef guard in linear_int8_input_block.glslh (quantize helper, not the GEMM loop)
8da4w.inner_loop: tile TILE_M4=1, TILE_K4=1, TILE_N8=1 -> 4 M x 8 N per thread (yaml:13-15). Per k4: load 4 packed int8x4 activations + one ivec4 of 32 int4 weights (glsl:125-126); unpack nibbles with &0x0F0F0F0F and >>4 (glslh:33-34); 32 dotPacked4x8AccSatEXT (signed int8 dot4 with saturating int32 accumulate, GL_EXT_integer_dot_product) (glslh:39-49). After each 128-K group: zero-point/sum correction and fp fma into the output tile (glsl:132-144, glslh:56-83).
8da4w.roof_match_caveat: roofline dot_int8 uses dotPacked4x8EXT on uint operands + separate add (unsigned, non-saturating; igpu-roofline/shaders/dot8.comp:24), whereas stock uses the signed saturating accumulate form. Whether both lower to the same native instruction was not checked on any GPU.

stock_kernel_instructions.not_in_gemm_time: 8da4w activation quantize is a separate dispatch (~23-167 ms per 8B prefill, report/evidence/trace/families.csv); 4w 'tin' reads a transposed activation buffer produced by another dispatch.
